gloss: to excuse oneself; to be rude; to take one's leave

definitions.gloss: to excuse oneself; to take one's leave
definitions.explanation: A polite way of saying one is leaving or entering a space. Commonly used when departing from a gathering or entering someone's office or room.

definitions.gloss: to be rude; to commit a discourtesy
definitions.explanation: To do something impolite or to behave rudely toward someone.

examples.japanese: お{先|さき}に{失礼|しつれい}します。
examples.english: Excuse me for leaving before you.

examples.japanese: それでは、{失礼|しつれい}いたします。
examples.english: Well then, I'll take my leave.

examples.japanese: {社長室|しゃちょうしつ}に{入|はい}るとき「{失礼|しつれい}します」と{声|こえ}をかけた。
examples.english: When entering the president's office, I said 'Excuse me.'

examples.japanese: お{名前|なまえ}を{間違|まちが}えるとは{大変|たいへん}{失礼|しつれい}しました。
examples.english: I'm terribly sorry for getting your name wrong.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{目上|めうえ}の{人|ひと}に{対|たい}して{失礼|しつれい}なことをしてしまった。
examples.english: He ended up being rude to someone senior to him.

notes:
USAGE:
This is one of the most common polite expressions in daily Japanese life. お{先|さき}に{失礼|しつれい}します is the standard phrase for leaving work before colleagues. {失礼|しつれい}します is used when entering someone's room or office.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{先|さき}に{失礼|しつれい}します (excuse me for leaving first — said when leaving work)
- {失礼|しつれい}いたします (humble form: I'll take my leave)
- {失礼|しつれい}しました (I was rude — an apology)
- {大変|たいへん}{失礼|しつれい}しました (I was terribly rude)

REGISTER:
The いたします form is more formal/humble than します.
